# PoundFighter: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-08 · code f5446e0018f9 · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Micro workouts for your workday, turned into a monster-collecting game: do reps in bed, at your desk or standing, count them by voice, and capture 36 monsters.
**Live:** https://poundfighter.com · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/poundfighter · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/poundfighter/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py poundfighter` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **The engine is JavaScript, the app is Forms.** `theme/assets/app/js/pf.js` (an ES module loaded in head_html; it
  imports data/store/mic/sfx/monster-art/ui.js) owns the game state and rules and sets `window.PF`, then resolves
  `window.PFReady` (an inline script in head_html). `client_code/pf.py` waits for it (`pf.start()` in startup.py),
  reads plain JSON views (`pf.view("home" | "shop" | "me" | "summary" | "collection", tab | "monster", id | "chrome")`)
  and changes things only through `pf.act(name, value)` (ACTIONS in pf.js). New game feature = data.js/store.js +
  a view field + an action in pf.js, then the Form.
- **Fight screen** = `Components/Arena`: on the Fight page's show it calls `PF.fightStart(el, pos)` (not awaited: the
  mic may ask for permission) and the engine draws by element id (`$('stage')` etc.), so only one fight at a time.
  The engine calls Python hooks set in pf.start(): `finished` (-> #summary + reminders.after_session), `quit`,
  `confirmEnd` (a confirm() dialog; JS gets a Promise), `toast`, `saved` (debounced account sync).
- **Sync**: pf.sync_now() moves JSON between `PF.syncOut/syncIn` and the server's `sync_progress`; the merge rules
  are in store.js `mergeStates` and server `merge_progress` (keep them identical).
- **Mic tuning** = `Dialogs/MicTest`; the meter elements keep the engine's ids (tLvl, tBase, tThr, tCount).
- **Push**: the service worker stays at `_/theme/app/sw.js` with scope `_/theme/app/` (old subscriptions keep
  working); `reminders.py` makes the server calls, `PF.push` does the browser part. Install prompt: head_html
  captures `beforeinstallprompt` and fires a `pf-install` window event.
- **Server runtime** moved from python3-full to python314 + `server_code/requirements.txt` (cryptography, bcrypt,
  requests). push.py imports them inside try/except so a missing package only breaks reminders (the local App
  Server has no cryptography). Test reminders and Change password on hosted Anvil.
- **Dark only**: app-kit.js always applies the dark theme (the game was never light). Engine icons are inline
  `<svg class="ic">`: app.css turns icons.css's mask off for `svg.ic`.
- Tests: `tools/ui/smoke.js` (guest incl. a real fight, member sign-up + sync, admin); `tools/ui/promote.py` makes the
  smoke admin an admin over Uplink (container started with `--uplink-key`; needs `pip install --user anvil-uplink`).
  GitHub's default branch is the old `dev0`: always work from `master`/`forms`.
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Data tables (`anvil.yaml` db_schema)

- **app_settings**: key:str, value:obj · used in push
- **feedback**: created:dt, status:str, kind:str, message:str, email:str, user→users, context:obj, admin_note:str · used in ServerModule
- **progress**: user→users, data:obj, updated:dt · used in ServerModule
- **push_subscriptions**: endpoint:str, keys:obj, user→users, prefs:obj, tz_offset:num, created:dt, last_sent:dt, last_active:dt, fails:num · used in ServerModule
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, is_admin:bool, remembered_logins:obj, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str · used in ServerModule

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
